sections.kicker: Prepared for Apéritif by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Apéritif is a Parisian café on Instagram and a cookie shop on its own site.
sections.keep: The silver trays, gold tiered stands and striped banquettes in your grid. They already show what Parisian means.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.what: The first screen sells a loud cookie to a Parisian house.
pins.why: The bio says timeless Parisian cafés. The homepage says messy and gooey, so the two do not describe the same brand.
pins.how: Decide if the cookie is a guest in the Parisian world or a second brand.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Visitors from the cafés land on a different brand than the one they know.

pins.area: Silver trays, gold tiered stands and striped banquettes in the grid
pins.what: The grid already shows a Parisian world nobody else in the mall has.
pins.why: Trays, lamps and tiered stands are specific. They are the answer to why Apéritif and not the cafe next door.
pins.how: Name that world in one phrase and use it on every surface.
pins.label: Your grid
pins.cost: A real point of view is left to the photographs to explain.

pins.quote: A decade of defining the art of grazing.
pins.what: Ten years of grazing tables sit in one caption.
pins.why: Grazing is what earned your name, and the site and the bio lead with cafés and cookies.
pins.how: Let the grazing heritage back the whole brand.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: The craft that took ten years to build looks like a side business.
